chapter: Compositions, singers and the end of the big band
title: Roll call of band alumni and Sonny Payne
summary: Goines reads the roster by section; Hawkins recalls Payne from Atlantic City and the memorial list.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
